(Nasdaq: MIST) today reported financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and announced cost-efficiency measures designed to extend cash runway through the topline results from its Phase 3 trial of etripamil in atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular rate (AFib-RVR), while preserving the sales force and core commercial activities for CARDAMYST ® (etripamil) nasal spray.

• Ongoing Phase 3 pivotal trial (ReVeRA-301) evaluating etripamil nasal spray in atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular rate (AFib-RVR) is on schedule; topline data expected in the second half of 2028.

Importantly, we expect these measures to extend our cash runway beyond the anticipated Phase 3 readout of ReVeRA-301 in the second half of 2028.” Key elements of the cost-efficiency measures include: · Bringing the sales force in-house: the Company plans to retain the existing field sales team of approximately 45 dedicated representatives, transitioning them from a contracted model to company employees at a lower overhead cost while maintaining current sales coverage.

Forward-looking statements contained in this press release include statements regarding: the continued commercialization and adoption of CARDAMYST and Milestone’s planned commercial priorities; the implementation, timing and anticipated benefits of Milestone’s cost-efficiency measures and associated one-time charges; the anticipated reduction in operating expenses of approximately 30%; planned leadership changes and their timing; Milestone’s continued funding and development of the Phase 3 AFib-RVR program, the expected timing of topline data from ReVeRA-301 and the program’s potential value to Milestone; the estimated addressable patient population for AFib-RVR; the anticipated sufficiency of Milestone’s cash resources to fund operations into late 2028 and through the anticipated ReVeRA-301 readout; and other statements not related to historical facts.
